employers.description: A leading global information technology, consulting and business process services company.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer (React)

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: Join our data science team to build predictive models and analyze large datasets to improve delivery times.
jobs.requirements: Experience with Machine Learning algorithms, Python, Pandas, Scikit-learn. SQL proficiency is a must.

jobs.title: Social Media Executive
jobs.description: Manage our social media presence across Twitter, Instagram, and Facebook with creative campaigns.
jobs.requirements: Excellent copywriting skills, understanding of social media metrics, and a good sense of humor.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Manager
jobs.description: Oversee end-to-end supply chain operations, optimizing logistics and delivery networks.
jobs.requirements: MBA in Supply Chain or Logistics. 5+ years of experience in e-commerce logistics.

jobs.title: UI/UX Intern
jobs.description: Looking for an enthusiastic intern to assist our design team in creating wireframes and prototypes.
jobs.requirements: Basic knowledge of Figma, understanding of user-centered design principles. Portfolio required.
